verdict.rationale: Fireflies' API is GraphQL, and its docs describe introspection for discovering the schema, which is a machine-readable spec equivalent. Introspection runs through the built-in Apollo Sandbox at api.fireflies.ai/graphql and needs an API key, so there is no static downloadable spec file; the OpenAPI probes at all candidate paths returned 404. missing for 10: a publicly downloadable static schema file (SDL/JSON introspection dump or OpenAPI), documented unauthenticated download path, independent corroboration that introspection exports a full usable schema.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Introspection is a feature that allows querying a GraphQL server to discover its schema.
For introspection using our builtin Apollo Sandbox, visit api.fireflies.ai/graphql and enter your api_key in the Headers section as a Bearer token
The Fireflies API is built on top of GraphQL
